_about: Inputs from the fourth check of the pure-app gate (two independent checkers after round 3): emergencies and hazards told only in app words with a leading "otis" ("otis 1 is down", "otis can i run it now"), numbers standing for people ("2 down", "the app is stuck and so is 1 of mine"), words for how a person is ("stuck up there", "lost contact", "esta pegado", "se ve muy mal"), going down or black, giving up, and report-flow descriptions that name nothing of the app; plus attacks of our own on what is left of the vocabulary.
Left out on purpose: "otis ya no contesta" (an app complaint in otis-gate-cases-2.json; the first checker left it out of its totals).
Low, still open: "who should i contact" (shows "Who to contact for help", which says to call 911 first, with the 911 line) and "leak@dock" at the email step (read as a mistyped email).
